description: Source code for tuner studio I/O handling, including serial communication, USB serial, DMA transfer, and console port management.

classes.name: ts_channel_s
classes.description: Structure representing a tuner studio communication channel, including buffers and channel references.

methods.name: startTsPort
methods.description: Initializes and starts the tuner studio communication port, selecting between USB serial, UART, or simulator based on configuration.

methods.name: stopTsPort
methods.description: Stops the communication port if applicable, depending on the configuration.

methods.name: sr5WriteData
methods.description: Sends data over the tuner studio port, handling DMA or serial modes.

methods.name: sr5ReadDataTimeout
methods.description: Reads data with a timeout from the tuner studio port, using DMA or serial depending on configuration.

methods.name: sr5ReadData
methods.description: Reads data without explicit timeout from the tuner studio port.

methods.name: sr5WriteCrcPacket
methods.description: Constructs and sends a packet with CRC, including size, response code, and payload.

methods.name: sr5SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response either with CRC or plain data based on mode.

methods.name: sr5IsReady
methods.description: Checks if the tuner studio port is ready for communication, considering USB or serial mode.
